entries.0bdf0c0aa514bdbb: Renewal (replacement and renovation of automatic doors)
entries.1455a4a02e0ebddb: This is a business category not included in the reportable segments. It includes the development, design and manufacture of embedded control circuit boards by the consolidated subsidiary Y's Corporation; the Environmental Equipment Business, which sells, installs and maintains smoking area systems as a sales agent of Tornex Corporation; the Security Business, which sells entry and exit management systems, security gates and crime prevention products; and the bicycle parking system business. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥856 million.
entries.1dfd4ff08d0090b9: It is a division that replaces existing automatic door opening and closing devices and carries out renovation, including renovation involving stainless steel sashes. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,029 million.
entries.437c98e03f47276b: Renovation involving stainless steel sashes and other items
entries.489353b8d62207e8: Replacement of automatic door opening and closing devices
entries.5c2d8f5514a23801: It is a business that manufactures and sells fittings, whose main products are stainless steel sashes and doors (frame doors, tempered glass doors, etc.). These are mainly sold together with automatic door opening and closing devices. Production of stainless steel sashes and other items is handled by the consolidated subsidiary Artex Co., Ltd. at its Sapporo and Morioka factories. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,038 million.
entries.6018bfd773a82c2f: A Sapporo-based company that sells, installs and maintains automatic door opening and closing devices, and manufactures and sells stainless steel fittings.
entries.6ebb8e2366095ad8: Automatic Door Opening and Closing Devices
entries.90a15d7747819ead: It is a division that carries out inspection, adjustment and repair of installed automatic doors based on regular inspection maintenance contracts concluded with building owners and building managers. The number of units under maintenance contracts for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was 93,022, and sales were ¥4,201 million.
entries.9b0366a789d7d446: It is a division that sells and installs automatic door opening and closing devices in newly built buildings and other structures. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,440 million.
entries.d4cb3eefc2bae9a7: It is a business that sells, designs, installs and maintains automatic door opening and closing devices, and carries out renovation (remodeling), including replacement of opening and closing devices and renovation involving stainless steel sashes. Through a network of 38 locations centered on Hokkaido, Tohoku and the Kanto region, the company takes orders in an integrated in-house system, from sales and design to construction mainly performed in-house and 24-hour, 365-day maintenance services. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥8,671 million.
entries.f44db7a0e2ae5c6e: Maintenance and inspection services for automatic doors
